text: Cognition operates Devin, the first autonomous software engineer. Cognition helps engineers operate more like architects: strategizing, designing systems, and focusing on problem solving, while agents handle the repetitive engineering work. Its headquarters are in San Francisco and it has raised over $400M from Founders Fund, Lux Capital, 8VC, Bain Capital Ventures, and other leading investors.
short: Cognition operates Devin, the first autonomous software engineer; it is San Francisco-based and venture-backed.
